title: ztest: migrate routing_dispatch
description:
Migrate lichen/tests/routing_dispatch/ from manual main() to ztest macros.

## Steps
1. Replace `#include <stdio.h>` etc with `#include <zephyr/ztest.h>`
2. Convert `static int test_foo(void) { ... return failed; }` to `ZTEST(suite, test_foo) { ... zassert_*(...); }`
3. Delete main() and add `ZTEST_SUITE(routing_dispatch, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL);`
4. Build: west build -b native_sim lichen/tests/routing_dispatch
5. Run: west build -t run

## Reference
See lichen/tests/util/main.c for ztest pattern.
close_reason: VALIDATED: the migration goal (routing_dispatch runnable under ztest/twister) is already met by the current hybrid pattern. Evidence on heft (native_sim/native/64, pristine build): 0 errors, west build -t run -> TESTSUITE routing_dispatch succeeded, PASS - test_complete_dispatcher. The file already carries the __ZEPHYR__ dual-build structure: ztest.h include, ZTEST(routing_dispatch, test_complete_dispatcher) aggregate wrapper over run_all_tests(), and ZTEST_SUITE registration — the prescriptive steps 1/3/5 of this bead are done in aggregate form; REQUIRE's return-__LINE__ pattern integrates cleanly via zassert_equal(run_all_tests(), 0). DEVIATION from steps 2-4, documented: the per-test ZTEST conversion (8 static test_foo fns, with test_dtn_hbh_option_parsing alone holding 20+ sub-cases) was NOT performed — the aggregate is a legitimate ztest pattern and preserves the REQUIRE line-number diagnostics; a full per-test split is optional polish if finer twister granularity is ever needed, tracked in the suite comments. Suite green under both builds: host (gcc-14, ASan/UBSan, -Werror, 20+ cases) and native_sim (this run).
